svg.title: Dreams function review by game system
svg.desc: 63 of 9551 function names checked. 1560 functions have evidence-backed system assignments; 7991 functions do not. Sections show evidence-backed associations with parts of Dreams. Every square is a real function. Each labeled component owns a separate equal-square grid below its heading. Headers and unused final-row space are not functions. Green means behavior or helper code reviewed; blue means property or type registration code reviewed; amber means unresolved; gray means unreviewed. Assignments are incomplete; full system totals and completion are unknown.

g.text: Section counts = checked names / identified functions
7,991 functions still unmapped. Names checked includes properties/types; this is not whole-system completion.
